meta.name: i18n-localization
meta.description: Internationalization and localization patterns. Detecting hardcoded strings, managing translations, locale files, RTL support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测硬编码字符串并管理多语言翻译
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码中提取字符串并管理翻译文件
copy.tagline_en: Detect hardcoded strings and manage translation files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract strings and manage locale files in your codebase

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你检查代码中的硬编码字符串，建议改用翻译键，并生成或更新本地化文件（如 JSON），同时处理日期、数字格式和 RTL 布局。
howto.when: 当你处理需要支持多语言或区域化的项目（如公共网站、SaaS 产品），或要求检测硬编码字符串、管理翻译文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 React 组件里有没有硬编码的字符串。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并建议替换为翻译键。

say.text: 为我的项目添加土耳其语本地化支持。
say.note: Claude 会创建对应的 locale 文件并指导集成。

say.text: 如何为阿拉伯语设置 RTL 布局？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you detect hardcoded strings in code, suggests using translation keys, generates or updates locale files (e.g., JSON), and handles date/number formatting and RTL layout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working on projects that need multi-language or regional support (e.g., public web apps, SaaS products), or when asked to detect hardcoded strings or manage translation files.

say_en.text: Check this React component for hardcoded strings.
say_en.note: Claude scans and suggests replacing with translation keys.

say_en.text: Add Turkish localization support to my project.
say_en.note: Claude creates locale files and guides integration.

say_en.text: How to set up RTL layout for Arabic?
say_en.note: Claude provides CSS logical properties and dir attribute examples.
